units.source_text: 劇場內座無虛席，鎮上與父親關係親近的人幾乎全都趕來捧場，並用力地鼓掌。

en.t: The theater was packed, and nearly everyone in town who was close to Father had come to show support, applauding vigorously.

units.source_text: 演講結束後，聽眾三五成群地沿著夜晚的雪道回家，

en.t: After the speech ended, the audience went home in little groups along the snowy night roads,

units.source_text: 大家議論紛紛，把今晚的演講貶得分文不值，

en.t: everyone talked it over noisily and tore that evening's lecture to pieces,

units.source_text: 其中也摻雜著與父親過從甚密者的聲音。

en.t: and among those voices were some belonging to people especially intimate with Father.

units.source_text: 父親那些所謂的「同志們」用近乎憤怒的語氣，批評父親的開場致辭如何如何拙劣，那位名人的演講更是多麼的語無倫次、不知所云等等。

en.t: Father's so-called comrades spoke in tones close to anger, criticizing how poor Father's opening remarks had been and how incoherent and unintelligible the famous man's speech was, among other things.

units.source_text: 之後，那幫人順道來到我家，坐進客廳，

en.t: Afterward, those people stopped by my house on their way, came into the parlor,

units.source_text: 臉上便堆滿笑容，對父親說今晚的演講太成功了。

en.t: then put broad smiles on their faces and told Father that the evening's lecture had been a tremendous success.
